case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 8962-8963 OF 2022 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (C) NOS. 6122-6123 OF 2022)
summary: Agreement to sell dated 03.13.2007; Rs.3 lakh earnest money paid; buyer's readiness and willingness for specific performance; conflicting pleadings by seller on execution of agreement; Trial Court decree for specific performance upheld based on buyer's readiness; High Court reversed on grounds of lack of buyer's readiness; Supreme Court examines precedent on evidentiary standards for readiness (Indira Kaur, Beemaneni Maha Lakshmi, Ramrati Kuer); High Court error in reappreciating evidence on readiness; reliance on J.P. Builders and U.N. Krishnamurthy by respondent.
legal_provisions_cited: Indira Kaur v. Sheo Lal Kapoor (1988) 2 SCC 488
Beemaneni Maha Lakshmi v. Gangumalla Appa Rao (2019) 6 SCC 233
Ramrati Kuer v. Dwarika Prasad Singh (1967) 1 SCR 153
J.P. Builders v. A. Ramadas (2011) 1 SCC 429
U.N. Krishnamurthy v. A.M. Krishnamurthy 2022 SCC OnLine SC 840
